ui.app.tagline: The English of your drive test, in your language.
ui.onb.welcome: Learn what the examiner will say.
ui.onb.micBody: Say each phrase out loud. Roadword listens and tells you how close you were.

ui.stage.car.info: Before you drive, the examiner checks the car. You show controls like the horn, wipers, and arm signals.
ui.stage.dir.info: Turns and going straight. The examiner tells you where to go.
ui.stage.lane.info: Changing lanes, pulling over, and going back into traffic.
ui.stage.park.info: Backing up straight, parking, and returning to the DMV.
ui.stage.talk.info: What the examiner says before the test, and one phrase you can say.
ui.stage.res.info: Comments you may hear after the test, and pass or fail.
ui.stage.exam.info: No translations, just like the real test. Listen and react.

ui.pro.title: Profile
ui.info.title: How it works
ui.info.p1: Roadword teaches the exact English phrases a driving examiner uses in California.
ui.info.p2: Each stop has short lessons. You listen, choose, build, and speak each phrase.
ui.info.p3: The real drive test is in English with no interpreter in the car. The mock exam works the same way.
ui.info.p4: Not affiliated with the California DMV.
ui.info.source: Phrases based on the DMV examiner phrase sheet (DL 80).
ui.gen.error: Something went wrong. Reload the page to try again.
ui.drill.title: Quick reaction
ui.drill.body: Commands come fast, in different voices. Tap the action before time runs out.
ui.drive.title: Drive test
ui.drive.body: Like the real test: English only, no help. The car moves on its own. You signal, steer, brake, and check your blind spot when the examiner tells you.
ui.drive.unsupported: This device can't show the 3D test. The mock exam will open instead.
ui.drive.cSignal: Turn signals: tap before every turn, lane change, pull over, and when leaving the curb.
ui.drive.cLook: Blind spot: tap the eye to look over your shoulder before changing lanes, pulling over, or leaving the curb.
ui.drive.cSteer: Steering: tap left or right of the wheel. At a corner it turns. Between corners it changes lanes or pulls to the curb.
ui.drive.cPedals: Pedals: hold the brake to stop. Tap the gas to go after a stop.
ui.drive.cGear: Gear: P to park, R to back up, D to drive.
ui.drive.failBody: Up to 15 errors and no critical errors are needed to pass.
ui.err.ranStop: Didn't stop at the stop sign
ui.chk.title: Test day checklist
ui.chk.driver: A licensed driver to drive you there. You can't drive alone on a permit.
ui.chk.insurance: Proof of insurance for this car
ui.chk.glasses: Glasses or contacts, if your permit requires them
ui.chk.lights: Working brake lights and turn signals, front and back
ui.chk.glass: A clear windshield, two mirrors, and a driver window that opens
ui.chk.inside: Working seat belts, a passenger door that opens, and a closed glove box
ui.chk.wait: Wait in your car in the drive test line.
ui.chk.noHelp: No interpreter or passenger can ride with you.
ui.chk.ask: You may ask: "Can you repeat that, please?"
ui.chk.source: Based on the California DMV driving test guide (DL 955). Rules can change; check dmv.ca.gov.

phrases.car.armLeft: Show me the arm signal for a left turn.
phrases.car.armRight: Show me the arm signal for a right turn.
phrases.car.armStop: Show me the arm signal for slow or stop.
phrases.car.key: Turn on the key. Do not start the engine.
phrases.car.signalLeft: Turn on the left turn signal.
phrases.car.signalRight: Turn on the right turn signal.
phrases.car.parkingBrake: How do you set the parking brake?
phrases.car.flashers: How do you turn on the emergency flashers?
phrases.car.headlights: How do you turn on the headlights?
phrases.car.wipers: How do you turn on the windshield wipers?
phrases.car.defroster: How do you turn on the defroster?
phrases.car.auto: Is your vehicle equipped with automated technology?
phrases.dir.lightLeft: Make a left at the next light.
phrases.dir.lightRight: Make a right at the next light.
phrases.dir.stopRight: At the stop sign, turn right.
phrases.dir.follow: If I don't say turn, follow the road ahead.
phrases.lane.necessary: Make necessary lane changes to follow my directions.
phrases.lane.back: When it's safe, pull back into traffic.
phrases.lane.safe: Perform all maneuvers only when safe.
phrases.park.dmv: Take me back to the DMV.
phrases.talk.evaluated: You will be evaluated on your ability to drive safely.
phrases.talk.trick: I will not trick you or ask you to do anything illegal.
phrases.talk.noAuto: Do not use cruise control or other automated features.
phrases.res.blindSpot: You didn't check your blind spot.
phrases.dir.stopLeft: At the stop sign, turn left.
phrases.lane.pullAway: Pull away from the curb when it's safe.
phrases.sys.done: We're done. Let's go back to the DMV.
